prompt:
Does any thread of crunch keep a CPU close to 100% busy for most of the run? If so, which thread, and how much CPU does it use?

Begin your answer with exactly one line: "Verdict: yes", "Verdict: no", or "Verdict: cannot tell from this trace". Then answer the question.
answer:
Verdict: no

Across the trace (0–30,521.8 ms), none of the assessed crunch threads stayed close to 100% CPU for most of the run. They averaged about 10.6–10.8% CPU over roughly 30 seconds; even their busiest 100 ms windows reached only 16.4–17.1%.

The highest total was calc-6 (TID 637554): 3,239.2 ms of CPU time, or 10.8% of its 29,938.9 ms lifetime. Its busiest 100 ms window used 16.4% CPU.
